title: Record detail: a multi-file field renders in half a row with its file names cut off, and the author has no way to widen it there
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible layout).
reach: public entry — the console record detail panel in a browser (Playwright, zh-CN, 1440×900), measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## Business reason

An expense claim carries its e-invoices in one `file` field with `multiple: true`. On the claim, the approver sees `taxi-invoice-2431200000012345678…` / `hotel-invoice-243120000009876543…`, so they cannot tell the invoices apart by name, which is the field's whole content.

## What happens

- **Form:** the field is half-width by default; the author fixes it with `{ field: 'invoices', span: 'full' }` in the form section (measured: 455px → 926px). Fine.
- **Detail panel:** the same field sits in the right half of the overview grid and its file names are truncated with `…`. `applyAutoSpan` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts`, `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`) widens only textarea / markdown / html / grid / richtext; a file field never qualifies. The object field has no layout key the author can set to change this (the form's `span` does not reach the detail panel), so the AI builder cannot fix it either.

## Expected

Either a `file` / `image` field with `multiple: true` counts as wide in the detail panel (as it does in practice for its content), or the form's `span: 'full'` (or a field-level hint) is honoured there too.

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (`plugin-detail` auto layout).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue detail file field span full width` → 29 hits (#28913 highlight strip in edit mode, closed, different); `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES file` → 6 hits (#18516 closed: the spec describe named file as wide but the renderer did not — the describe was corrected, the renderer left as is); `multi-file field detail truncated` → 13 hits, none on this.
